description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the schedule to the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1950/27 of 19.01.2016 in relevant to the National School of Business Management Limited
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Higher Education and Highways amending the schedule of degrees offered by the National School of Business Management Limited under the Universities Act. While it mentions a minister by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title). The content primarily concerns educational matters (degree program amendments at a business school), which falls under the Miscellaneous category as it involves academic appointments/degree certifications rather than core government structure, personnel changes, or any of the specialized categories 4-9.
